name: Lethean-Veil
description: Sand owns this world, in colors from bone-white to burnt sienna, migrating with the seasons before a patient wind. Where the gusts strip it away, tectonic rift valleys emerge like the bones of the planet.
Thin air makes every breath a small transaction. Locals, when there are locals, move slowly and speak quietly, conserving everything.
Instruments disagree about the signal of unknown origin: mass reads one value, inertia another. Probes sent in return transmitting their own launch signals, timestamped hours early.
The charts mark this world in cautious amber. Those who ignore the marking tend to come back rich, changed, or not at all.
